_verdict_reasoning: THE TWO AXES ARE REPORTED SEPARATELY AND THEY DO NOT CONFLICT. (1) RETRIEVED PRECEDENT carries the verdict: 6,340 distinct compounds on Q99572, best CHARACTERISED antagonist potency 0.05 nM (CHEMBL550030, conf 9, a named human-THP1 functional antagonist assay, small_molecule by structure), and five clinical-stage small-molecule antagonists across at least three chemotypes (CE-224535 Ph2, AZD9056 Ph2, JNJ-54175446 Ph2, ZANVIPIXANT Ph2, GSK1482160 Ph1; all Small molecule/MOL, rule 1a). This is direct measured small-molecule tractability. (2) COMPUTED TRACTABILITY is reported and is CONCORDANT but NOT load-bearing: the allosteric antagonist site is a real, ligand-confirmed inter-subunit pocket captured in two antagonist-bound cryo-EM structures (9E3O A1BD8, 9E3P A1BD9), ligand-anchored (Jaccard 0.42-0.47 at D=1.6), all-on-target (on_target_residue_fraction 1.0), pre-formed and occupied by a sub-nanomolar antagonist. fpocket nonetheless scores it LOW druggability (0.003-0.013 at D=1.6) and buries it at fpocket rank 69 - the textbook DRUG-BOUND-POCKET FALSE NEGATIVE that rule 4.0 describes; a potent antagonist is literally bound in the pocket the score calls undruggable. AXIS_CONFLICT DECISION = null (no genuine conflict). The low fpocket druggability is NOT a competing 'not-tractable' claim: druggability is a within-structure rank, is not load-bearing (rule 4.0/4a), and here exhibits the exact false-negative rule 4 warns against, so treating it as a disagreement would BE the error. This is a within-computed-axis caveat, not an axis_conflict. Volume (D=1.6 154-259 A^3 fpocket / 767 A^3 mdpocket site_from_ligand at CV 3.2%) is modest but real and also points to a bindable cavity. Both axes therefore agree the site is bindable. CLINICAL FAILURE IS NOT AN AXIS AND DOES NOT ENTER THE VERDICT. AZD9056 and CE-224535 both failed Phase 2 in rheumatoid arthritis for lack of efficacy; per rule 7 these are recorded in terminated_programs as a within-precedent caveat and MUST NOT lower the tractability number. Clinical efficacy in RA is a different question owned by other stations. as_of_date is null, so there is no as_of_leakage entry; the terminations live in terminated_programs.

9E3O antagonist A1BD8 = (3s,5s,7s)-N'-(2-chlorophenyl)adamantane-1-carbohydrazide, C17 H21 Cl N2 O, 21 heavy atoms.

tractability._primary: Volume is an absolute physical quantity (comparable across structures, carries no verdict). Druggability is a WITHIN-STRUCTURE rank; reportable form is site_pocket_rank. This is a DRUG-BOUND-POCKET FALSE NEGATIVE case (rule 4.0): fpocket scores the ligand-occupied antagonist site 0.003-0.013 at D=1.6 and ranks it 69th, with a sub-nM antagonist physically bound.

pocket_volume_a3._primary_note: primary_d1_6_a3 = 154.5 A^3 is the ligand-anchored antagonist site pocket of the HEADLINE holo entry 9E3P at D=1.6 ONLY (Jaccard 0.421 vs the A1BD9 contact set). The other holo entry 9E3O gives 258.9 A^3 at D=1.6 (Jaccard 0.474). min/max pool BOTH structures AND both clustering values (legitimate for volume, which is absolute): at D=2.4 BOTH structures merge into the central vestibule - 9E3O 3170.0 A^3, 9E3P 3974.4 A^3, merge_suspected=True, ligand_site Jaccard collapses to 0.23/0.18 and the lining expands from two protomers to A/B/C - so the D=2.4 volumes are a merged-site artifact, not the antagonist pocket. mdpocket site_from_ligand (site fixed by construction, one grid over both structures) gives the antagonist pocket at 767 A^3 (749.4/784.6, CV 3.2%) - the reproducible cross-check. THE 210/240 A^3 GUIDE IS WITHDRAWN (rule 4a); do not classify with the volume.

pocket_druggability._comparability: WITHIN ONE STRUCTURE (9E3P), ACROSS THE D SWEEP - the only legitimate range. 0.013 at D=1.6 and 0.984 at D=2.4, both the ligand-anchored antagonist site pocket. This is NOT pooled across structures (that would be the rule-4.0 type error). The 76-fold move is the clustering knob, not biology: at D=2.4 the pocket has MERGED into the >3000 A^3 central vestibule (merge_suspected=True, Jaccard 0.42->0.18), so the 0.984 is a merged-site artifact, not a druggable-site score. 9E3O shows the same pattern (0.003 -> 0.991).
pocket_druggability._provenance: shipped fpocket 4.2.3: 3-descriptor logistic regression fitted on 21 positive pockets. Its dominant term is min-max normalised over the CURRENT STRUCTURE'S own pocket list (pocket.c:736-756; 132-161 pockets per structure here), so the score answers 'how does this pocket rank against the others in this file', never 'how druggable is this pocket'. A weak prior, not a probability.
pocket_druggability._false_negative_rate: REPORTED, NEVER LOAD-BEARING, NEVER COMPARED ACROSS STRUCTURES. Named case, not a percentage (the 41% figure's denominator is under audit): THIS RUN IS a clean drug-bound false negative - 9E3O and 9E3P are 2.5-2.8 A cryo-EM holo structures with a sub-nanomolar allosteric antagonist physically bound (Jaccard 0.42-0.47, on_target_residue_fraction 1.0), and fpocket scores that ligand-occupied pocket 0.003 and 0.013 at D=1.6 and ranks it 69th of 132/134. Druggability may not carry a not_tractable or insufficient_evidence verdict on its own.
pocket_druggability._do_not_max: max_druggability_no_ligand_site did NOT fire: all four measurements were anchored by ligand_site_jaccard (on_target_residue_fraction 1.0, no off-target lining chains at D=1.6).

site_pocket_rank._note: THE REPORTABLE FORM OF DRUGGABILITY. Claim: 'fpocket rank 69 of 134 in 9E3P at D=1.6; PRANK rank 7'. Two within-structure orderings on the same footing; they DISAGREE and the disagreement is reported - PRANK promotes the ligand-anchored antagonist site (9E3P 69->7, 9E3O 69->10 at D=1.6; both ->1 at D=2.4 where the pocket has merged), the n=70 pattern (promotes 79%). Even after PRANK the site is not rank 1 at D=1.6 - a shallow inter-subunit allosteric cleft that binds sub-nM antagonists yet does not rank as a top geometric pocket.

ensemble_consensus_fraction._note: Published criterion kept as an anti-cherry-picking control, NOT read as a tractability signal (AUC 0.560).
ensemble_consensus_fraction.source: pocket_scan Modal run 2026-08-16: ensemble.n_structures 2 (9E3O, 9E3P) x D in {1.6,2.4} = 4 measurements. The ligand-anchored antagonist site pocket was located and ligand-confirmed in 4 of 4 (ensemble.site_pockets_ligand_confirmed = 4). The tool emits no consensus fraction and 'strong hot spot' has no threshold this pipeline sets, so the fraction is null (see not_found), not invented.

tractability.site_hypothesis_basis: holo ligand site - 9E3O:A1BD8 and 9E3P:A1BD9, drug-like allosteric antagonists auto-classified 'druglike' by pocket_scan and asserted as the anchor. Selected per structure by ligand_site_jaccard (0.474 for 9E3O, 0.421 for 9E3P at D=1.6). The site is inter-subunit: 9E3P D=1.6 pocket lines chain A (8 residues) plus C/298; 9E3O lines chain A plus B/95; the full antagonist contact shell spans chains A, B and C. lining_chain_accessions confirm every lining chain is Q99572 (a homotrimer, no foreign polymer).
tractability.site_centroid_to_ligand_note: The reported volumes/ranks are fpocket's; the mdpocket cross-check used site_from_ligand (the ligand site by construction, distance 0 - volume 767 A^3, CV 3.2%). The 9.31 A recorded here is rule 4b's off-site check on the OTHER definition, site_from_density: the most persistent cavity in the ensemble sits 9.31 A from the 9E3O antagonist centroid, PAST the proposed (not calibrated) 4 A threshold, carries off_site_warning, and is the on-axis central vestibule (volume ~5,560 A^3) - correctly NOT used as the antagonist site. Reporting site_from_density as the ligand site would reproduce the retracted TNF-alpha 7.7 A error; it was avoided.

cryptic_evidence._note: The apo census a cryptic call would rest on (Vajda 2018).
cryptic_evidence.basis: NOT RUN. pocket_scan's cryptic stage is a pairwise apo-vs-holo superposition and needs at least one apo and one holo in the ensemble; the ensemble here is two antagonist-HOLO structures (0 apo), so cryptic_status='not_run' and no census was made. is_cryptic is null (unmeasured), NOT false. Whether the antagonist pocket is pre-formed or forms only in the closed/antagonist state is genuinely open - the ATP-agonist structure 9E3N and the detergent-only 9E3M could serve as the apo/alternate state in a follow-up (see next_experiment).
cryptic_evidence.definition: Vajda et al. 2018 stringent form (cryptic only if absent in all/nearly all unbound structures), CryptoBench pocket-residue RMSD > 2 A - not evaluable here without an apo comparator.
cryptic_evidence.source: pocket_scan cryptic stage, 2026-08-16: cryptic_status 'not_run', reason 'needs both an apo and a holo structure; got 1 holo reference and 0 apo'.

cryptic_potency_prior._note: Mechanism is a prior on achievable potency; not evaluable without the cryptic census.
cryptic_potency_prior.basis: Not evaluable: the cryptic census was not run (holo-only ensemble). The OBSERVED antagonist potency is empirical and sub-nanomolar (0.05 nM characterised), independent of any cryptic prior.

pocket_vs_interface._note: Measured, not assumed. Requires a complex containing the partner.
pocket_vs_interface._why: The interface stage was not run: no partner_structures were supplied, and pocket_scan refuses to assert orthosteric/allosteric without a complex containing the partner. The mechanism is nonetheless supported structurally without this module: the antagonist pocket is inter-subunit (lines two protomers of the homotrimer) and is a DISTINCT site from the ATP orthosteric agonist site (captured separately in 9E3N), consistent with allosteric antagonism. A formal classification against the ATP site is a follow-up (see next_experiment). There is no heterologous protein partner - the disrupted interaction is a nucleotide agonist (ATP), analogous to the IRAK4 orthosteric case that also used no_partner_structure.

tractability.caveat: Read the computed axis with three things in mind. (1) It is REPORTED but does NOT carry the verdict (verdict_basis = retrieved_precedent). Read on its own it says: a real, ligand-confirmed, pre-formed inter-subunit antagonist pocket of 154-259 A^3 (fpocket, D=1.6) / 767 A^3 (mdpocket site_from_ligand, CV 3.2%), occupied by a sub-nanomolar antagonist. (2) fpocket's LOW druggability here (0.003-0.013, rank 69) is a DRUG-BOUND-POCKET FALSE NEGATIVE (rule 4.0), not evidence against the site - a potent antagonist is physically bound in it. Druggability is a within-structure rank and is not load-bearing; it is NOT an axis_conflict with the retrieved precedent, it is the documented blind spot. (3) D=2.4 is unusable for this site: both structures merge into the >3000 A^3 central vestibule (merge_suspected, Jaccard collapse), so the D=1.6 numbers and the mdpocket site_from_ligand volume are the site measurements. Chain selection was ASSERTED (A,B,C) because the site is inter-subunit; a single protomer would not contain it. Cryptic/interface stages were not run (holo-only ensemble; no partner complex) - see those fields.

affinity._why_null: Rule 13: no affinity predictor in this deployment, so rule 12's mandatory positive control is unsatisfiable rather than skipped - a null with a stated reason, never a prediction without a control. P2X7 has excellent controls to hand (e.g. CHEMBL550030, 0.05 nM characterised) had a predictor existed.

checks_run: 1. Do the actives collapse to one assay/lab? GROUP BY assay_description with a window-function share over 30,621 activities. Top single assay is a human-P2X7 inhibitory-activity assay at 3,696 rows = 12.1%; next 6.5%/5.1%/4.9%. Nothing near rule 6's ~30%. CHECK RUN, NOTHING FOUND.

1b. Is the dominant assay measuring a different protein? No - the 12.1% assay measures human P2X7 itself (the target), unlike the TNF-alpha/IRAK4 cross-readout case. measures_a_different_target = false. CHECK RUN, NOTHING FOUND.

2. Is the best potency from a characterised assay? The MAX pchembl (0.01 nM, CHEMBL2324343) is from 'Inhibition of P2X7 receptor (unknown origin)' - UNCHARACTERISED, excluded per rule 6 (the same failure mode as MYC's 0.2 nM 'unknown origin'). The reported best (0.05 nM, CHEMBL550030) is a conf-9 named human-THP1 functional antagonist assay; a cluster of conf-9 characterised antagonist assays spans 0.05-0.09 nM. FOUND (excluded one uncharacterised MAX), verdict stands on characterised data.

3. Do the actives collapse to one series or one lab? Not fully resolvable to chemotype in this run (the GROUP BY assay_id / full-SMILES census is blocked by the transport preview-cap and shared-connection timeouts), but bounded: the potent end spans at least three unrelated chemotypes visible in the top-60 SMILES - adamantane/tetracyclic carbohydrazides, isoquinolinone adamantane-acetamides, and cyanoguanidine/triazole antagonists - and five distinct clinical assets from five companies (Pfizer, AstraZeneca, Janssen, GSK, +ZANVIPIXANT). A single-series artifact cannot produce that. PARTIALLY RUN.

4/5. Is the structure a single-crystal-form or additive artifact? The antagonist site appears in BOTH holo structures (9E3O A1BD8, 9E3P A1BD9), ligand-anchored (Jaccard 0.42-0.47) in all D=1.6 measurements - not one crystal form. DETERGENT TRAP CHECKED: all four entries contain Y01 (cholesteryl hemisuccinate, a detergent) and GDP; pocket_scan correctly classified Y01 'lipid_or_detergent' and GDP 'cofactor' and anchored to the antagonist A1BD8/A1BD9, avoiding the RORgt-6C1P/CD20 detergent-anchor error. FOUND (Y01 present) AND CORRECTLY NOT USED.

6. Are frequent hitters / PAINS being counted? Not checked against a PAINS/aggregator database, so structure.bound_ligand.is_known_frequent_hitter stays null (not false). The bound antagonists (adamantane/tetracyclic carbohydrazides) are established med-chem, not obvious PAINS. PARTIALLY RUN.

7. Were clinical programs terminated, and why? FOUND: CE-224535 (Pfizer, Ph2 RA) 'not efficacious versus placebo' (Stock 2012, J Rheumatol, DOI 10.3899/jrheum.110874) and AZD9056 (AstraZeneca, Ph2 RA) stalled with the class showing lack of RA efficacy (Cheah 2025, PMC12607368). Both recorded in terminated_programs. Per rule 7 these are efficacy failures and DO NOT lower the tractability verdict; RA efficacy is another station's question.

8. Are off-target / repurposing look-alikes being counted as P2X7 drugs? FOUND, AND IT IS THE SHARPEST RESULT. The compounds max_phase>=1 path (rule 2d, high-recall/low-precision) returns BRILLIANT BLUE G and CANNABIDIOL at max_phase 4.0 and SURAMIN at 3.0 - all 'Small molecule'/'MOL' but approved/advanced for OTHER uses (BBG is a dye, cannabidiol an anticonvulsant, suramin an antiparasitic), with weak/no P2X7 pchembl (BBG 6.27, suramin 4.48). None is an approved P2X7 drug: approved_small_molecules_count = 0. OXATOMIDE, IMD-0354, BERBERINE similarly off-target. EVT401 (in drugs_by_accession) is molecule_type 'Unknown'/'NONE' -> modality_unknown, NOT counted as a small molecule (rule 1a). FOUND (all excluded).

9. Is the low computed druggability being read as evidence against tractability? Watched for and explicitly rejected: fpocket 0.003-0.013 at D=1.6 is a drug-bound-pocket false negative (rule 4.0), a within-structure non-load-bearing rank, NOT an axis_conflict with the sub-nM retrieved precedent. It did not enter the verdict. CHECK RUN, NOTHING FOUND (the number is correctly non-load-bearing).
findings: The MAX potency (0.01 nM, CHEMBL2324343) is an uncharacterised 'unknown origin' readout and is excluded (rule 6); the reported best (0.05 nM) is a conf-9 characterised antagonist assay.
All four human-P2X7 cryo-EM entries carry Y01 (cholesteryl hemisuccinate, a detergent); the scan anchored to the antagonist, not the detergent - the RORgt/CD20 trap was avoided.
Off-target/repurposing molecules (Brilliant Blue G and cannabidiol at max_phase 4, suramin at 3) inflate the compounds path but are not approved P2X7 drugs; approved P2X7 small molecules = 0.
EVT401 (in drugs_by_accession) is molecule_type 'Unknown'/structure_type 'NONE' - stays modality_unknown, not counted as a small molecule (rule 1a, no Open Targets cross-check per rule 13).
CE-224535 and AZD9056 both failed Phase 2 in rheumatoid arthritis for lack of efficacy - a within-precedent caveat (rule 7), not evidence against small-molecule tractability.

next_experiment.description: On the tractability axis the question is already answered on retrieved precedent (sub-0.1 nM characterised antagonist, five clinical-stage small molecules). The experiments worth running characterise the site, not the verdict: (a) run pocket_scan's cryptic stage with the ATP-agonist structure 9E3N (or the detergent-only 9E3M) as the apo/alternate comparator to test whether the allosteric antagonist pocket is pre-formed or forms only in the closed/antagonist state; (b) run the interface stage against 9E3N to formally classify the pocket as allosteric relative to the ATP orthosteric site; (c) complete the full 6,340-compound modality census and the GROUP BY assay_id chemotype-provenance query, both blocked here by the Paperclip transport (preview-cap and shared-connection timeouts).
next_experiment.rationale: More computed-tractability evidence would not change a verdict already carried by direct measured small-molecule precedent. The residual uncertainty is the site's state-dependence (cryptic vs pre-formed) and the breadth of the chemical matter, neither of which alters the tractability call and the first of which the drug-bound false negative makes worth characterising.
next_experiment.resolves: Whether the inter-subunit allosteric antagonist pocket is conformationally gated, its formal allosteric-vs-orthosteric classification, and whether the small-molecule precedent is broad across chemotypes or concentrated - none of which changes the small_molecule_tractable verdict, and rule 7 forbids letting the RA clinical failures change it.

Read the computed axis with three things in mind. (1) It is REPORTED but does NOT carry the verdict (verdict_basis = retrieved_precedent). Read on its own it says: a real, ligand-confirmed, pre-formed inter-subunit antagonist pocket of 154-259 A^3 (fpocket, D=1.6) / 767 A^3 (mdpocket site_from_ligand, CV 3.2%), occupied by a sub-nanomolar antagonist. (2) fpocket's LOW druggability here (0.003-0.013, rank 69) is a DRUG-BOUND-POCKET FALSE NEGATIVE (rule 4.0), not evidence against the site - a potent antagonist is physically bound in it. Druggability is a within-structure rank and is not load-bearing; it is NOT an axis_conflict with the retrieved precedent, it is the documented blind spot. (3) D=2.4 is unusable for this site: both structures merge into the >3000 A^3 central vestibule (merge_suspected, Jaccard collapse), so the D=1.6 numbers and the mdpocket site_from_ligand volume are the site measurements. Chain selection was ASSERTED (A,B,C) because the site is inter-subunit; a single protomer would not contain it. Cryptic/interface stages were not run (holo-only ensemble; no partner complex) - see those fields.
